en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a historic European town built along a small river. In the center stands a tall round stone tower on a fortified base beside a narrow bridge crossing the river. Nearby is a large Gothic‑style church with a steep spire and tall pointed windows. Surrounding them are dense clusters of traditional gabled houses with tiled roofs, set against rolling open fields in the background. The image has the framing and composition typical of an old picture postcard. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image.
